handoff_note: Done, merged into master. Market data in src/worker/market/: Twelve Data client, D1 cache (market_cache) and shared request budget (api_budget: 7/min, 780/day). Checked locally against the real API: search, AAPL quote, 1M chart, BTC/USD. Next: A03-film078 (search UI) and A03-statue382 (details page), both unblocked now.
human_check_steps:
In a terminal, in `/Users/wanghui/coding/ticker` (with `TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY` in `.dev.vars`):

1. `npx wrangler d1 migrations apply ticker --local`, then `npm run dev`.
2. Open http://localhost:5173/api/search?q=apple: Apple Inc. on NASDAQ comes first, marked `"available":true`.
3. Open http://localhost:5173/api/quote?symbol=AAPL: Apple's latest price, day change and 52-week range.
4. Open http://localhost:5173/api/chart?symbol=AAPL&range=1M: about a month of hourly prices.
5. Reload step 3 a few times: the `fetchedAt` time stays the same (it comes from the cache).
label: locally verified
title: The server answers search, quote and chart requests from Twelve Data, cached and within the free plan's limits
